BOTH REMAINING CALENDAR RUNS, AND THEY WERE THE SAME ARGUMENT TWICE. 72 -> 53.

The 10-line run was customOptions + viewDidMount, byte-identical in
calendar_common_renderer.js and calendar_year_renderer.js; the 9-line run was
their shared import block. Both are gone because the two renderers now have a
base. What the gate could not report is the reason there was one to build: 16 of
the year renderer's 21 members shared a name with the common one, and three of
those were PREFIXES rather than copies -- onDayCellDidMount, onEventDidMount and
eventClassNames were exactly the head of the common ones, which then append.
Byte-exact detection sees a prefix as no duplication at all, which is the right
trade for a ratchet and the reason this pair sat at 19 units for so long.

Measured in clean worktrees: 72 at ac6b7c05d45, 53 with the two commits on top.
The remaining 5 runs are outside views/.
